Transparency & Operations

Frequently Asked Questions

Why are these infrastructure allocations priced significantly below retail? +

Marketio provisions millions of monthly outbound touches across our client roster and procures wholesale enterprise allotments in bulk. Rather than letting surplus partner allotments sit idle, we release excess capacity directly to peer agencies and growth operators at near-cost wholesale rates.

What is the Marketio 100% Replacement Warranty SLA? +

Every license and admin console allocated through the Vault is backed by a strict 24-hour replacement SLA. If any account experiences an administrative flag, limitation, or downtime during its active tenure, our engineering team replaces or re-provisions it within 24 hours at zero charge.

Do you require access to my personal passwords or existing accounts? +

Never. Upgrades (such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator) are activated through private official invitation links without sharing passwords. Dedicated consoles (Google Workspace & M365) are handed over as fresh Global/Super Admin tenants where you immediately set your own credentials.

What payment methods are supported for allocation requests? +

We accept Stripe (Credit/Debit Cards), Wise, direct Bank Wire (ACH/SWIFT), and USDT/Crypto for international agency operators. Payment invoices are issued immediately upon allocation reservation.

Can Marketio manage and run outreach campaigns on this infrastructure? +

Absolutely. If you want turnkey outbound execution rather than managing infrastructure yourself, our AI Growth Engine deploys autonomous SDR agents that prospect, warm mailboxes, and book high-ticket meetings on autopilot.
